subtitle_source: User-supplied video; local Vision OCR of lyric highlight row sampled every 0.5 seconds; OCR errors normalized. Published LRC timing cross-checked with a 33.0-second offset. Group boundary agreement within 0.5 seconds for stable OCR rows, excluding scrolling transient frames. Sentence timing, not forced word alignment.

music_pulse.basis: Two late chorus windows both detect 136 BPM; half-time 68 used for subtle character motion. Earlier window ambiguous at 159 BPM.

visual_reference: Reference is a vertical scrolling lyric video, not a character animation. All narrative visuals newly authored.
character: Unmodified clawd.js from painted-animation template; supporting character uses same model with rose palette and flower hat.
style: Code-rendered p5.js and p5.brush, seeded watercolor fills and ink.
audio: AAC stream copied from the supplied MP4, no external music downloaded.
